title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The integrated protection and basic needs programme in Bekkaa Valley in Lebanon is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 3.1: Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. Activities and outcome include provide -psycosocial support, emergency cash assistance to those with serious protection risks and GBV survivors with GBV case management so , women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Programmes are in partnership with Lebanese Women Democratic Gathering (RDFL), SAWA for development and aid and Women Now for Development. ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Women’s protection and access to specialised GBVsupports- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
